post.title: Building RAG system pipelines using Open source LLMs
post.description: Our submission for the course project is building a RAG pipeline by using multiple embedding systems where the RAG enhances language model responses by retrieving relevant information from the dataset provided along with the query given.
post.excerpt: Project description In this project, we build a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system for question answering on the HotpotQA dataset…
